reviewed_high_value_regions.note: Broad and orthogonal recall converge on one RCC-lineage reform regime. Unified county RCCs, rural cooperative banks and rural commercial banks are alternative legal/governance outcomes; provincial unions are cross-entity management/service layers; public recapitalization is historical-loss allocation and incentive conditionality. Legal form alone does not define a second period-wide business model.

known_major_gaps: BANK-RURAL 1990-1994, 1995-1999 and 2000-2004 are broad+orthogonal complete. TIME-2005-2008 is the next unopened primary slice.

The 2005-2008 broad challenge should recover post-reform expansion and commercialization of RCC/RCB franchises; wider rural commercial-bank/cooperative-bank conversions; new-type rural financial institutions including village-bank emergence without confusing them with RCC lineage; provincial-union governance and technology scaling; household/SME/agriculture credit growth; postal-savings-bank transition and rural funds recycling; deposit competition and liquidity; capital/NPL seasoning after cleanup; and the first impact of 2007 tightening/2008 global stress on rural institutions.

Exact histories, reform dates, balances, ratios, ownership structures, village-bank sponsorship terms, merger/conversion terms, outlet counts and official classifications remain Evidence-stage questions.
Evidence remains deferred while BANK-RURAL is unsealed.
